query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Wayne Fueling Systems and Unknown Party; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold:
Obligations in this Section 2 regarding Confidential Information shall, with respect to each disclosure of Confidential Information hereunder, continue for three (3) years from the date of each disclosure of Confidential Information. Nothing herein is intended to limit or abridge the protection of trade secrets under applicable trade secrets law, and trade secrets shall be maintained as such until they fall into the public domain.
No such termination of the Agreement or return or destruction of the Confidential Information or Notes will affect the confidentiality obligations of the Receiving Party, its Affiliates, or its or their Authorized Parties, all of which will continue in effect as provided in this Agreement.
rag_answer: Yes. The document states that termination will not affect the confidentiality obligations of the Receiving Party, its Affiliates, or Authorized Parties, and that those obligations “will continue in effect as provided in this Agreement.” It also provides that Section 2 confidentiality obligations continue for three years from each disclosure, and trade secrets remain protected until they fall into the public domain.

judge.gold_summary: 协议终止、保密信息返还或销毁不影响接收方及其关联方/授权方的保密义务；第2条保密义务自每次披露起持续三年；商业秘密在公开前仍受保护。
judge.answer_summary: 回答确认协议终止不影响接收方、关联方及授权方的保密义务，并指出第2条保密义务自每次披露起持续三年，商业秘密在公开前仍受保护。
judge.reason: 系统回答完整覆盖了金标中的关键要点：保密义务在协议终止后继续、三年期限以及商业秘密持续保护，且未与金标矛盾。
